scope: MiniMax-H3 T-shirt folding language planner, material hard gates, and fail-closed test-time scaling harness
summary: The harness now compiles the left-sleeve, right-sleeve, body-fold, and move-aside instruction into a hash-bound causal plan; H3 proposals can scale over frozen seeds and inference steps; and independent camera-frame cloth, order, continuity, first-frame, background, and terminal-state gates reject failures without mean-score override. CPU tests, plugin validation, static-condition compilation, and plan-only integration pass. A new H3 candidate has not yet passed the frozen hard gates, so the task remains PARTIAL.
evidence: 45 focused CPU tests passed for the physical-video harness and existing AC-WM workflow
The full repository CPU suite reached 927 passed and 1 skipped; one pre-existing JoyAI timeout assertion failed on unmodified origin/main
plugins/physical-video-planner passed both skill and plugin validation
lessons: A visually plausible aggregate score cannot establish sleeve conservation; endpoint and segment material tracks must be independent fail-closed gates.
Test-time scaling must vary seeds, inference steps, and gate-specific repair text while leaving all thresholds and initial landmarks frozen.
A static scene reference avoids encoding abrupt edited target states into the H3 condition; the target motion must come from the causal language plan.
limitations: The cloth checks are camera-pixel production gates, not metric 3-D inextensibility, force, collision, or executable robot evidence.
The previous keyframe-composed video failed multiple hard gates and is not an accepted deliverable.
Native-resolution human review remains a veto after all automatic gates pass.
next_actions: Run the frozen MiniMax-H3 scaling policy on the A800 host and evaluate every candidate independently.
Deliver only a candidate that passes every automatic hard gate, then request native-resolution human review.
